sources.note: Town of Huntington (official website), Selectboard page: Dori Barton (Chair, term expires 2027), Landel Cochran (Vice Chair, 2027), Troy Liberty (2029), Roman Livak (2028), and Karen Barber (2028). The page postdates the March 2026 meeting (Liberty's 2029 term)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): the directory seats the same five
Town of Huntington (official website), Town Clerk page: the Town Clerk is Heidi Racht, elected to a three-year term expiring 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Huntington Town Clerk is Heidi Racht
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: Huntington Town Clerk is Heidi Racht
Town of Huntington (official website), Town Treasurer page: the Town Treasurer is Andrea Ogilvie, who also serves as the town's tax collector (no separate Collector of Delinquent Taxes post)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Huntington Treasurer is Andrea Ogilvie
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: Huntington Treasurer is Andrea Ogilvie

Town of Huntington (official website), Board of Auditors page: Dan Towle (term expires 2027), Patricia Quinn Baumann (Chair), and Marilyn Hinsdale (2028). Baumann's printed term expired in 2026; the town's maintained page -- on the same site whose Selectboard page is post-meeting current -- continues to seat her as Chair, so she is minted as re-elected with the stale expiry field disclosed

Town of Huntington (official website), Board of Listers page: the town has elected listers; the page seats Diane Coles (three-year term, 2028) and Elizabeth Cote (2029). The third seat is absent from the page and is left unfilled

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the listing names seven justices of the peace for Huntington

Town of Huntington (official website), homepage post: Justice of the Peace Beverly Little Thunder died in office; the Board of Civil Authority recommended Barrett Grimm and the Governor appointed him in mid-April 2026 to fill the vacancy. Huntington has seven JPs

Town of Huntington (official website), homepage post: after JP Beverly Little Thunder's death, the Board of Civil Authority sent Barrett Grimm's name to the Governor, who appointed him in mid-April 2026 to fill the JP vacancy

jp_election.name: Huntington Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the winners were Heidi Racht, Mary Taft, Don Dresser, Patricia Quinn Baumann, Shelley McSweeney, Beverly Little Thunder, and Pam Alexander (seven seats). Little Thunder died in office in 2025-26 and is not minted as a current holder; the Governor appointed Barrett Grimm in mid-April 2026 to fill her seat (see the membership record), so the winners array carries the six living elected justices
the town's homepage post records Little Thunder's death and Grimm's gubernatorial appointment
